# Move R collector/runtime history commit-map

This file is git-filter-repo's `commit-map` output from the Move R extraction that
produced this branch's history for `packages/local-collector/`,
`packages/collector-runtime/`, `packages/connector-protocol/`, and the vendored
build-time sources they compile against (`packages/polyfill-connectors/` connector
directories + a closed set of its `src/*.ts` runtime-support files,
`packages/reference-contract/src/common/` + `src/evidence/{collection-scope,
named-collection-scope}.ts`, and `docs/reference/local-collector.md`, later
relocated within this repo to `packages/local-collector/docs/`).

The extraction's `--path` list included each of these packages' current
directories AND the individual pre-split file paths where their content used to
live before the in-monorepo `engine-split` commits carved `@pdpp/collector-runtime`
and `@pdpp/connector-protocol` out of `@pdpp/polyfill-connectors`
(`packages/polyfill-connectors/src/*.ts`, flat, plus
`packages/polyfill-connectors/src/runner/`) — without those extra `--path` entries,
`git log --follow`/`git blame` on the moved files would stop at the engine-split
commit instead of reaching the monorepo's initial contribution. This was caught and
fixed during Move R execution (see this repo's Move R report, §1): an earlier pass
of this extraction omitted the pre-split origin paths for files native to
`collector-runtime`/`connector-protocol` themselves (as opposed to the vendored
`local-collector` build inputs, which were correct from the start), and `git blame`
did not reach back correctly. This is the corrected, final map after adding those
paths plus the reference-contract evidence pair and the relocated doc file.

Format: two whitespace-separated 40-character SHA-1s per line, `old<TAB>new`,
one line per commit filter-repo processed in the source clone
(`~/.tmp/pdpp-filter-src`, branch `engine-split-slice2`, at commit `9942a9d208ef23b266ca5b0e9f1d3e442d154aaf`).
`old` is the commit's SHA in the pdpp monorepo (any ref reachable in that clone,
not just `engine-split-slice2` — filter-repo processes all refs in the repository
by default, so this map also covers commits reachable only from the clone's many
other local/remote-tracking branches; only the `engine-split-slice2` lineage below
was actually fetched and merged into this repository).

- `new` = all-zeros (`0000000000000000000000000000000000000000`): the commit did not
  touch any of the extracted paths and was dropped.
- `new` = a real SHA: the commit's tree, filtered to only the extracted paths,
  survives at that SHA in the filtered history. Multiple `old` SHAs can map to the
  same `new` SHA when filtering collapses an original commit's non-matching changes
  away entirely, leaving it identical in content to its parent within the filtered
  tree.

Total lines below (excluding this header): 18166
Commits with a real (non-zero) new SHA: 1384 (1291 distinct new SHAs)
Commits dropped (all-zero new SHA): 16782

The branch `move-r-collector-runtime`'s own history for these paths descends from
new SHA `68e26e6833d33644b80deff0ccdf922e34430fb0` (old SHA
`9942a9d208ef23b266ca5b0e9f1d3e442d154aaf`, the `engine-split-slice2` branch tip at
extraction time) — that is the one lineage of this map that is actually merged into
this repository; the rest of this map documents filter-repo's full-repo processing
of the source clone and is kept for traceability, per Move R's requirement to
preserve an old-commit-to-new-commit(s) mapping artifact.

Generated by: git filter-repo (see this repo's Move R report for the exact
invocation and path list).
